title: Calculation of Action-Plan Relief Points — Seller Performance Standing
content:
**Calculation.** The active points for action-plan relief are the points of every violation recorded on the standing record, less every point reversed and every point already expired or relieved on that record. The action-plan relief covers the active listing policy points, meaning the points recorded for listing policy violations less every point expired, relieved or reversed on entries carrying that type; it is those points multiplied by the action-plan share of 0.25 and rounded down to a whole point, and it never exceeds the action-plan cap of 2 points. The product is worked to four decimal places before it is rounded down.

These are the points a Seller Performance Standing action-plan relief takes off the seller's standing record.

## The figures that enter

| Figure | Read from the seller's standing record |
|---|---|
| Listing policy points recorded | the points of every violation recorded with the type listing policy |
| Listing policy points taken out | every point on points-expiry entries (expiries and reliefs) and reversal entries carrying the type listing policy |
| Active listing policy points | the first figure less the second |
| Share | 0.25 |
| Cap | 2 points |

The relief is the active listing policy points multiplied by 0.25, worked to four decimal places, rounded down to a whole point, and held at 2 points where it would be higher.

## Worked figures (hypothetical records)

| Listing policy points recorded | Taken out on listing policy entries | Active listing policy points | Multiplied by 0.25 | Rounded down | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0 | 6 | 1.5000 | 1 | 1 |
| 10 | 2 | 8 | 2.0000 | 2 | 2 |
| 14 | 0 | 14 | 3.5000 | 3 | 2 (held at the cap) |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | 0.5000 | 0 | 0 |

Points of other violation types — restricted product, intellectual property, inauthentic complaint, product authenticity and review manipulation — do not enter the listing policy figures, and an entry carrying another type does not reduce them.
